newsitem.title: USA: Basin Electric 550 MW coal unit resumes production.
newsitem.headline: Basin Electric 550 MW coal unit resumes production.

text.p: Basin Electric Cooperative said the 550 megawatt (MW) Laramie River Station (LRS) coal-fired power unit 3 resumed power output late last week following a shutdown for a boiler tube leak.
"It came back on line late Friday afternoon as scheduled," a Basin spokesman said Tuesday.
The unit, located in Wheatland, Wyoming, was shut Feb 11 to repair the leak.
The plant's remaining two 550 MW units were also operating normally as of Tuesday morning, the spokesman said.
Basin Electric, headquartered in Bismark, North Dakota, operates and has a 42 percent interest in the plant, with five other Midwest utilities co-owning the remaining interest.
